open_questions: Travel is instant, costs trip_cost per leg, no travel time. Is that acceptable until T07/travel_cycles_per_leg?
Only one ship trades (it starts where the first ship was bought); extra ships are count-only until routes. OK?
How-to-trade explanation is a text block on the notification board, not a pop-up menu. Acceptable, or do you want a modal?
handoff: Every planet now shows Buy a ship. Per commodity with a price: Buy 1, Buy max, Sell all, disabled with a reason. 'Send ship here' on other planets moves the ship instantly for trip_cost. Top bar shows Energy/Food/Cargo used/cap. Mission steps: 1 buy ship (halo on energy_buy planet), 2 buy energy there, 3 send ship to the energy_sell planet, 4 sell all energy, 5 buy food, 6 send back, 7 sell all food, then completion line. Halo and board text follow the step. Hook for T07 route offer: main.gd _on_trade_mission_complete(). Autosave stores cargo, ship_planet, mission_step with defaults for old saves. Not verified: visuals, clicking, and the save round trip (user:// blocked); trade logic was checked with a headless script and the project loads clean. ship_panel.gd offset_top moved 170 to 380 so it does not overlap the guide text.

design_choices: step 2 completes at first energy bought, player should Buy max before leaving
